verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's H200 page is confirmed live and does contain a spec table with FP8 tensor figures and bandwidth/capacity numbers (per probe-rt-1), but the evidence pack itself surfaces mostly bare marketing multipliers ('2X faster than H100', '110X faster than CPU') rather than the actual precision-tagged TFLOPS/TOPS figures with sparsity conditions spelled out. Community commentary also notes the H200 reuses H100 silicon, adding skepticism to headline comparisons rather than to the raw spec numbers themselves. Missing for 10: explicit quoted TFLOPS/TOPS values per precision (FP8/FP16/INT8) with dense vs. sparse figures, and independent benchmark corroboration of those specific numbers.
